extDescription.message: Shows the travel direction of long-distance trains during seat booking on bahn.de

directionChanges.message: The travel direction changes during the journey as follows:

noValidityHint.message: No wagon order available for this date.

disclaimer.message: *Wagon orders may change on the day of travel.

donateAppeal.message: This is a hobby project – I’d appreciate a small donation!

obHeading.message: One click is all it takes

obSub.message: As soon as you select a seat on bahn.de, simply click the ICE icon at the top of your browser — and the direction of travel is shown immediately.

obPinTip.message: Tip: click the puzzle icon 🧩 next to the address bar and pin Train Direction so the icon is always visible.

fbQuestion.message: $1 on $2: Was the direction shown correct?

fbMore.message: $1 more trip(s) waiting for your answer.

fbThanks.message: Thanks! Your answer stays right here on your device.

statsLine.message: $1 booking(s) with direction shown · $2× confirmed · $3× wrong

privacyLocal.message: These numbers live only locally on your $1, inside this extension. There is no server – nothing is sent to us or anyone else.

sealText.message: Bookings and answers live only on your $1 inside this extension. Nothing is sent.
